# List users — `redmine_list_users`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_read-only_

Find Redmine users by name, status, or group — the way to turn a person's name into the numeric id that `assigned_to_id`, `author_id`, and `watcher_user_ids` require. Note that listing users requires admin permission on most Redmine instances; a non-admin API key gets a permission error, in which case ask the human for the id or use `redmine_get_current_user` for your own.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | integer | no | Account status: 1 active, 2 registered, 3 locked. Defaults to active users only. |
| `name` | string | no | Filter by login, first name, last name, or email (substring match, case-insensitive). |
| `group_id` | integer | no | Only users belonging to this group id. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Pagination offset (skip N users). |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of users to return. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_list_users",
  "arguments": {
    "status": 42
  }
}
```
